instruction: I don't want my screen to dim when I'm reading documents. Can you disable automatic screen dimming?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic screen dimming when idle. Config sets idle-dim to true, instruction asks to disable it. The evaluator checks if the setting is false. Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the idle-dim setting state using the appropriate gsettings command
Metric (exact_match) performs correct comparison for gsettings output format
Expected value 'false\n' is semantically correct - disabling screen dimming requires idle-dim to be false, and includes the newline character that gsettings outputs
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the single requirement stated in the instruction
Data flow is correct: config sets initial state to true, user should change to false, evaluator verifies the change
No edge case issues - gsettings command always returns a valid boolean value
